name: 01776 · Sudbury, MA
findings: ZIP 01776 (Sudbury) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01776 (Sudbury) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01776 (Sudbury) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
